title: Change Point Detection with Generative Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.34228v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Change point detection (CPD) methods aim to identify abrupt changes in the properties of time series, which is a key problem in numerous fields. A major class of CPD approaches relies on computing a CPD score, which is either a discrepancy or divergence between two subsequent samples, called windows. A fundamental limitation of window-based CPD is the 'sample size bottleneck.' To ensure temporal precision, windows must be small; however, small samples provide insufficient statistical evidence for the classifiers and deep-learning models currently used to compute CPD scores. This leads to high variance in the scores and frequent mispredictions. Our study tackles this issue by exploring generative models for window augmentation, effectively expanding available data to improve CPD quality. translated_title: 基于生成模型的变点检测
translated_abstract: 变点检测（CPD）方法旨在识别时间序列属性中的突变，这是众多领域中的一个关键问题。一大类变点检测方法依赖于计算变点检测分数，即两个相邻样本（称为窗口）之间的差异或散度。基于窗口的变点检测方法存在一个根本性局限，即“样本量瓶颈”。为了确保时间精度，窗口必须很小；然而，小样本无法为目前用于计算变点检测分数的分类器和深度学习模型提供充分的统计证据，导致分数方差过大和频繁的误预测。我们的研究通过探索生成模型进行窗口增广来解决这一问题，有效地扩展了可用数据以提高变点检测质量。在合成数据和真实数据上的实验表明，所提出的方法显著提升了变点检测性能。
tldr: 该论文提出利用生成模型对时间序列窗口进行数据增广，突破了基于窗口的变点检测中“样本量瓶颈”的根本局限，显著提升了变点检测的准确性与质量。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes using generative models for window augmentation to overcome the fundamental "sample size bottleneck" in window-based change point detection, significantly improving CPD accuracy and quality.
